products.name: BEAM LINE WELDING MACHINE / PULL THRU WELDING MACHINE
products.shortDescription: Automated pull-through welding solution for PEB and structural steel beam fabrication, designed for consistent weld quality, improved productivity and reduced manual handling.

description.paragraph1:
The Beam Line Welding Machine, also known as a Pull-Through Welding Machine, is an industrial welding solution designed for structural steel fabrication and Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) manufacturing.

The system is intended to support continuous beam welding operations by moving structural components through a designated welding station. Depending on the machine configuration, it can be engineered to improve welding consistency, reduce repetitive manual operations and streamline production workflows.

PAP Weld Core Automation provides industrial welding automation solutions tailored to customer-specific beam dimensions, production requirements and fabrication processes.
description.paragraph2:
The structural components are positioned and aligned according to the required fabrication procedure. The beam assembly is then guided through the machine's welding zone using the configured feeding and handling mechanism.

The welding system performs the specified welding operation as the component moves through the process. Depending on the selected configuration, the machine can incorporate welding torches, component guides, clamping arrangements, drive mechanisms and process controls.

The finished beam proceeds to inspection and subsequent fabrication stages in accordance with the customer's welding procedure and quality requirements.

The exact operating sequence and automation features depend on the supplied machine configuration.

keyFeatures: Continuous pull-through welding for high productivity
Deep penetration SAW process for structural integrity
Programmable settings for varying beam sizes
